title: Handling Event Grid Events with Azure Functions
description: Build event handlers in Azure Functions that respond to Event Grid events automatically.

data.text: Event Grid Trigger in Azure Functions

Azure Functions has a built-in Event Grid trigger that automatically validates your endpoint and delivers events. The function receives an array of events, and you can use the event type and data to route logic accordingly.

data.content: Handle multiple event types in one function:

data.text: When Event Grid delivers events to a webhook endpoint, it first sends a validation event. Your function must respond with the validation code to prove it owns the endpoint. The Event Grid trigger handles this automatically.

data.title: Validation Is Automatic
data.text: The Event Grid trigger in Azure Functions automatically handles the validation handshake. Do not manually process validation events when using the trigger binding.

terms.definition: A Functions binding that invokes a function when Event Grid delivers an event.
A special handshake event Event Grid sends to confirm your endpoint is valid.
Events that could not be delivered after retries are stored in a Storage blob if configured.

sequenceDiagram
    participant Source as Event Source
    participant EG as Event Grid
    participant F as Azure Function
    Source->>EG: Publish event
    EG->>F: Validation handshake
    F-->>EG: Validation response
    EG->>F: Deliver event
    F->>F: Process event
